ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area exceeding 90%, with sparse high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as stippling and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation (near-black) covering the entire visible ventral plane, punctuated by high-frequency white focal points and unaligned linear segments distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation centered at the fluke midline with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations with varying amplitudes (1-5 pixels) along the trailing boundary; a prominent macro-notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (scars) visible on the medial right lobe and the far distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe surface, with fewer visible on the left lobe due to water spray occlusion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular growth or cluster of sessile organisms (barnacles) localized at the distal tip of the left lobe (viewer's left).
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion caused by high-velocity water droplets (spray) localized in the central and left-central foreground of the fluke profile.
